why: searches rcl's runtime transition map for a `rcl_lifecycle_transition_t*`. Our transitions are a closed compile-time enum, so the lookup is a cast (`LifecycleTransition::from_u8`); there is no map to search and no heap object to hand back. See `c:lifecycle_transition_t`. OUR LANGUAGES DISAGREE: Rust exposes that conversion publicly as `LifecycleTransition::from_u8` / `from_shorthand`, C and C++ expose neither.
